# Star-Spangled Tycoon

> A lighthearted parody idle tycoon game for iPhone and iPad (also playable on the web). Free on the App Store.

## Play
- [App Store (app id 6816208938)](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6816208938): free on iPhone and iPad (the main way to play)
- [Play in your browser](https://rogerstheboss12-coder.github.io/play/): the same game on the web, no install
- [itch.io](https://starspangledtycoon.itch.io/star-spangled-tycoon): the web game on itch

## Docs
- [FAQ](https://rogerstheboss12-coder.github.io/faq/): common questions and answers
- [Guide](https://rogerstheboss12-coder.github.io/guide/): how the game works
- [Press kit](https://rogerstheboss12-coder.github.io/press/): fact sheet, features, images and logo

## Full text
